source_title: JKSSB JE Recruitment 2026: Notification Out for 458 Civil Posts; Apply Online Starts 30 November - Jagran Josh
source_excerpt:
JKSSB JE Recruitment 2026: The JKSSB has released the official notification for the recruitment to the JE Civil posts on 27 October 2026. The application process will start from 30 November 2026 at jkssb.nic.in. Check this article to know the eligibility criteria, application process, and other details.
JKSSB announced 458 JE (Civil) vacancies for Jal Shakti & PWD.
Notification released on 27 October 2026 for JE Civil posts.
Applications open from 30 November to 29 December 2026.
JKSSB JE Recruitment 2026: The Jammu & Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) has announced a total of 458 Junior Engineer (JE) vacancies for Civil in the Jal Shakti Department and the Public Works (R&B) Department. The notification was released on 27 October and the application process will commence from 30 November 2026. The interested candidates can download the official notification from the official website at jkssb.nic.in and read it carefully before the application process begins. The candidates can apply between 30 November to 29 December 2026.
Through this recruitment drive the JKSSB, is going to fill a total of 458 JE (Civil) vacancies. The notification is already released on the official website and the application process will commence from 30 November. Check the highlights of the recruitment in the table below:
Particulars Details Recruiting Authority Jammu & Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB) Department Name Jal Shakti Department & Public Works (R&B) Department, J&K Post Name Junior Engineer (Civil) Advertisement No. 11 of 2026 No. of Vacancies 458 Notification Release Date 27 October 2026 Application Dates 30 November to 29 December 2026 Pay Scale Level-6 (Rs. 35,400-1,12,400/-) Official Website jkssb.nic.in
Jammu & Kashmir Services Selection Board (JKSSB)
Jal Shakti Department & Public Works (R&B) Department, JK
The candidates who are planning to apply for the JKSSB JE recruitment 2026 should download the official notification and read it carefully before proceeding with the application. The notification contains all the important details about the recruitment such as the eligibility criteria, application process, application fee, scheme of examination, and other information.
The JKSSB will open the application portal for the JE Civil recruitment 2026 from 30 November onwards and the candidates can apply till 29 December 2026.
To be eligible to apply for the JKSSB JE recruitment 2026, the candidates must meet the certain eligibility criteria such as the educational qualifications and the age limit.
